rows: Babylonian cuneiform confirms sign ≠ reading ≠ referent; the LUGAL/šarrum case is the historical model
Babylonian determinatives provide the structural model for a class-marking operator that modifies without being pronounced
The Sefer 231-gate count is consistent with 22 signs + 1 non-participating operator, not with 23 ordinary letters
The Rosetta Stone establishes the parallel-text / shared-referent / no-sign-preservation decipherment method
The Marcosian–Sefer bridge is a Rosetta-type translation: shared planetary referent, non-sign-preserving, established via third structure
The Marcosian bridge is not a sign correspondence (Greek vowels ≠ Hebrew consonants)
The T(i)=8-i reversal depends on the specific Sefer recension's planetary assignments
Whether the specific recension's assignments are independently attested is the next historical test
